echo '[Unit]
Description=Wisent Compute local GPU agent (box-a)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment=WC_LOCAL_SLOTS=2
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=WC_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3
ExecStart=/home/u/.stado/bin/stado agent --target box-a
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30
User=u

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/wisent-compute-agent.service >/dev/null && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now wisent-compute-agent.service
